name: Lost in the Desert - Abu Fanous
desc:
Ready to face the horror you've never seen before?

In this game, you'll have an experience filled with ghosts, jinns, and terrifying creatures. and Abu Fanous

Every possible angle hides something for you that will freeze you from fear.

There are traps and darkness everywhere, and there's no safe place for it.

If you are strong and appreciate challenging your fear, enter and try your luck,

Just don't say you weren't warned!
